name: 0512FarmerJump
author: Jasonlin778
description:
How to control your characters :
(1)Press space to jump , you can triple jump if you press it three times.
(2)Press shift to dash , double scores , higher speeds , and more excitement!
As a soft reminder : If you play this game for the first time , you can practice without dashing . But after you get more skillful , just dash straight as many times as you can!
If you don’t want to read obstacles introduction , I allow you to  read section 7 merely.
Rumor has it that when a plane crash the stone arch , a catastrophe will strike immediately. ? _ ?
My best score is 11960 😈, can u beat me? :) Good Luck!


Obstacles introduction :
Be cautious ! Although you can leap three times in a row , there are seven sorts of cunning obstacles on the way to prevent you from going through the route!

Common kinds:
(1)garbage cans : They queue up tightly , just dash and jump to dodge them!
(2)stone arch : Do not double jumps , unless you consider you can hop to the sky and run very fast!
(3)triple boxes : Triple jumps always go along with triple boxes ! Double jumps to get rid of them.

Special kinds:
(4)plane : They only circle in the air , but they always remain at the same speed!
(5)Orange caps : Showing up with unity , orange caps always appear four times in a row.
(6)Stone walls : It is really crafty of them to blind your horizons ! Only dashing enables them to move faster.
(7)White fences : White fences never comes single , their color are the same as the ground , make sure that you are concentrate on observing the road every now and then .After the first white fence passes through , the second one will show up in random time and random position . Just like invisible ghost twins.
